1.1: Hannotea lisyag ulekorot, patur min haarla. rabbi yose omer, afillu amar happenimi lemaachol vehachitzon lisyag, happenimi chayyav, vehachitzon patur:
1.2: Et shebbau avotenu laaretz, matzu natua, patur. natu, af al pi shello chibbeshu, chayyav. hannotea larabbim, chayyav. rabbi yehuda poter. hannotea birshut harabbim, vehannachri shennata, vehaggazlan shennata, vehannotea bisfina, vehaole meelav, chayyav baarla:
1.3: Ilan shenneekar vehassela immo, shetafo nahar vehassela immo, im yachol lichyot, patur, veim lav, chayyav. neekar hassela mitztziddo, o shezzizeattu hammacharesha, o shezzizeo vaasao cheafar, im yachol lichyot, patur, veim lav, chayyav:
1.4: Ilan shenneekar venishtayyer bo shoresh, patur. vechamma yehe hashshoresh, rabban gamliel omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota, kemachat shel mittun:
1.5: Ilan shenneekar uvo verecha, vehu chayye mimmenna, chazra hazzekena lihyot kabberecha. hivrichah shana achar shana, venifseka, mone mishshaa shennifseka. sippuk haggefanim, vesippuk al gabbe sippuk, af al pi shehivrichan baaretz, muttar. rabbi meir omer, makom shekkochah yafe, muttar, vemakom shekkochah ra, asur. vechen berecha shennifseka vehi melea ferot, im hosif bematayim, asur:
1.6: Netia shel arla veshel kile hakkerem shennitarvu vintiot, hare ze lo yilkot. veim lakat, yaale veechad umatayim, uvilvad shello yitkavven lilkot. rabbi yose omer, af yitkavven lilkot veyaale veechad umatayim:
1.7: Healim, vehallulavim, ume gefanim, usemadar, muttarim baarla uvarvai uvannazir, vaasurim baashera. rabbi yose omer, hassemadar asur, mippene shehu peri. rabbi eliezer omer, hammaamid bisraf haarla, asur. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati beferush, shehammaamid bisraf healim uvisraf haikkarim, muttar, bisraf happaggim, asur, mippene shehem peri:
1.8: Ankoklot, vehachartzannim, vehazzaggim, vehattemed shellahem, kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello, kelippe egozim, vehaggarinim, asurim baarla, uvaashera, uvannazir, umuttarin barvai. vehannovlot, kullan asurot:
1.9: Rabbi yose omer, notin yichur shel arla, veen notin egoz shel arla, mippene shehu peri. veen markivin bechafniyyot shel arla:

2.1: Hatteruma, uterumat maaser shel demay, hachalla vehabbikkurim, olim beechad umea, umitztarfin ze im ze, vetzarich leharim. haarla vechile hakkerem, olim beechad umatayim, umitztarfin ze im ze, veen tzarich leharim. rabbi shimon omer, enan mitztarfin. rabbi eliezer omer, mitztarfin benoten taam, aval lo leesor:
2.2: Hatteruma maala et haarla, vehaarla et hatteruma. ketzad, sea teruma shennafla lemea, veachar kach naflu shelosha kabbin arla, o shelosha kabbin kile hakkerem, zo hi shehatteruma maala et haarla vehaarla et hatteruma:
2.3: Haarla maala et hakkilayim, vehakkilayim et haarla, vehaarla et haarla. ketzad, sea arla shennafla lematayim, veachar kach nafla sea veod arla, o sea veod shel kile hakkerem, zo hi shehaarla maala et hakkilayim, vehakkilayim et haarla, vehaarla et haarla:
2.4: Kol hamechammetz vehametabbel vehamedammea batteruma uvaarla uvechile hakkerem, asur. uvet shammay omrim, af metamme. uvet hillel omrim, leolam eno metamme ad sheyyehe bo kabbetza:
2.5: Dostay ish kefar yitma, haya mittalmide vet shammay, veamar, shamati mishshammay hazzaken sheamar, leolam eno metamme ad sheyyehe bo kabbetza:
2.6: Ulema amru kol hamechammetz vehametabbel vehamedammea lehachamir, min bemino. lehakel ulehachamir, min besheeno mino. ketzad, seor shel chittim shennafal letoch issat chittim, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, ben sheyyesh bo laalot beechad umea uven sheen bo laalot beechad umea, asur. en bo laalot bemea veechad, ben sheyyesh bo chede lechammetz, ben sheen bo chede lechammetz, asur:
2.7: Lehakel ulehachamir min besheeno mino, ketzad. kegon gerisin shennitbashshelu im adashim, veyesh bahem benoten taam, ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea, uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea, asur. en bahem benoten taam, ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea, uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea, muttar:
2.8: Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa, veyesh bo kede lechammetz, veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma, o seor shel kile hakkerem, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, asur:
2.9: Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa vechimmetzah, veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, asur. rabbi shimon mattir:
2.10: Tevalin, shenayim ushelosha shemot mimmin echad, o mishshelosha, asur, umitztarfin. rabbi shimon omer, shenayim ushelosha shemot mimmin echad, o shene minin mishshem echad, enan mitztarfin:
2.11: Seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch issa, lo baze chede lechammetz velo baze chede lechammetz, nitztarfu vechimmetzu, rabbi eliezer omer, achar haacharon ani va. vachachamim omrim, ben shennafal issur battechilla, ben bassof, leolam eno oser ad sheyyehe bo chede lechammetz:
2.12: Yoezer ish habbira haya mittalmide bet shammay, veamar, shaalti et rabban gamliel hazzaken omed beshaar hammizrach, veamar, leolam eno oser, ad sheyyehe bo chede lechammetz:
2.13: Kelim shessachan beshemen tame, vechazar vesachan beshemen tahor, o shessachan beshemen tahor, vechazar vesachan beshemen tame, rabbi eliezer omer, achar harishon ani ba. vachachamim omrim, achar haacharon:
2.14: Seor shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu letoch issa, lo vaze chede lechammetz velo vaze chede lechammetz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim:
2.15: Tevalin shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu bakkedera, lo vaelu chede letabbel velo vaellu chede letabbel, venitztarfu vetibbelu, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim:
2.16: Chaticha shel kadshe kadashim, shel piggul, veshel notar, shennitbashshelu im hachatichot, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim:
2.17: Besar kadshe kadashim uvesar kadashim kallim shennitbashshelu im besar hattaava, asur litmeim umuttar lithorim:

3.1: Beged shetztzevao viklippe arla, yiddalek. nitarev baacherim, kullam yiddaleku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaale beechad umatayim:
3.2: Hatztzovea melo hassit biklippe arla, vaarago veveged, veen yadua eze hu, rabbi meir omer, yiddalek habbeged. vachachamim omrim, yaale veechad umatayim:
3.3: Haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged, yiddalek habbeged. umissear hannazir umippeter chamor besak, yiddalek hassak. uvemukdashin, mekaddeshin kol shehen:
3.4: Tavshil shebbishshelo viklippe arla, yiddalek. nitarev baacherim, yaale beechad umatayim:
3.5: Tannur shehissikuhu viklippe arla veafa vo et happat, tiddalek happat. nitarva vaacherot, taale beechad umatayim:
3.6: Mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem, yiddaleku. nitarvu vaacherim, kullam yiddaleku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaalu beechad umatayim:
3.7: Shehaya rabbi meir omer, et sheddarko limmanot, mekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad. verabbi akiva omer, shiva. veellu hem, egoze ferech, rimmone vadan, vechaviyyot setumot, vechulfot teradin, vekulse cheruv, udelaat yevanit. rabbi akiva omer, af kikkarot shel baal habbayit. harauy learla, arla. lechile hakkerem, kile hakkarem:
3.8: Ketzad. nitpatztzeu haegozim, nitpardu harimmonim, nitpattechu hechaviyyot, nitchattechu haddeluim, nitparsu hakkikkarot, yaalu beechad umatayim:
3.9: Sefek arla, beeretz yisrael asur, uvesureya muttar, uvechutza laaretz yored velokeach, uvilvad shello yirennu loket. kerem natua yarak, veyarak nimkar chutza lo, beeretz yisrael asur, uvesureya muttar, uvechutza laaretz yored veloket, uvilvad shello yilkot bayyad. hechadash, asur min hattora bechol makom. vehaarla, halacha. vehakkilayim, middivre sofrim:
